messages:
Maya Patel: quick design check — attached mock shows a single floating control for streaming (Stop / Regenerate) on the right edge. thinking this reduces visual clutter but not sure about discoverability. thoughts? :thinking_face:
Alex Chen: I like the minimal approach. question: keyboard access? power users need a clear shortcut for interrupt + regen.
Samir Rao: dev note: we already have Esc bound to abort streaming in the runtime, but it collides with some editors. maybe Ctrl+. or Cmd+. as an alternative?
Jordan Lee: @Samir Rao can we expose the shortcut via the UI tooltip and in the prompt library docs? also we should surface the shortcut in the control's hover state.
Maya Patel: agree — tooltip shows "Stop (Esc or Ctrl+.)". visually the button label should be icon-only by default with accessible text via aria-label.
Priya Singh: accessibility nits: icon-only buttons without visible labels are fine if aria-labels are correct. ensure aria-live announcements when stream ends/interrupts — e.g., "Streaming interrupted by user" or "Response complete".
Samir Rao: noted. we'll add `aria-live="polite"` messages. also need to ensure focus is returned to the composer after interrupt. currently focus sometimes stays on the control.
Maya Patel: copy tweak — instead of "Stop" maybe use "Interrupt"? feels clearer that it won't discard the draft, just stops generation. open to bikeshedding.
Alex Chen: +1 for "Interrupt". "Stop" feels harsh. For regen button, microcopy should say "Regenerate response" on hover; icon-only default.
Jordan Lee: UX edgecase: if user presses regenerate while streaming we should queue a regen or show a confirmation? prefer immediate abort+regen to keep interaction snappy.
Samir Rao: implementation: abort current request then trigger a new generation. brief flash on the button to show action queued. add debouncing so accidental double taps don't spawn multiple calls.
Priya Singh: color contrast — the floating control's background uses 40% gray now; for low-vision users need 4.5:1 contrast with the icon. can we bump to the high-contrast token or add a focus ring?
Maya Patel: yes — use the accent surface token for focus and a 2px outline on keyboard focus. also add a reduced-motion variant for the token counter animation.
Alex Chen: token counter: do we show live token count when streaming? ops worried about telemetry churn. maybe show an approximate token gauge with "~123 tokens streamed" and update every 500ms.
Jordan Lee: fine from infra side if we batch updates. we'll emit telemetry every 5s for aggregate data, UI can sample locally more often.
Samir Rao: technical: make token counter an aria-hidden visual element and expose a separate sr-only announcement on completion: "Generated 125 tokens". avoids spamming screen readers during streaming.
Priya Singh: exactly — screen readers shouldn't get a flood. announce only on complete/interrupt. also ensure the regenerate button reads "Regenerate response — keyboard shortcut: Ctrl+." for screen reader users.
Maya Patel: prompt library integration: when user picks a prompt that has saved variables we should show estimated token cost before running (small badge under prompt title). copy: "Est. tokens: 45".
Alex Chen: product question — do we ever auto-summarize token impact for users on free tier? might help reduce surprise.
Jordan Lee: we can surface a tooltip with estimated cost but keep default off for enterprise. flag controlled.
Maya Patel: next steps: Samir to prototype focus behavior + keyboard shortcuts, Jordan to add telemetry hooks, Priya to run a quick a11y pass on the mock, Alex to write microcopy variants. I'll update the figma and ping for another quick review. :+1:
Samir Rao: on it — I'll try a prototype today and post a short video.
Priya Singh: will run with VoiceOver and NVDA once prototype is up.
ConsoleBot: deploy-notice: mock updated in Figma by Maya Patel at 1769004400.
Maya Patel: thanks all — ping me if anything blocks. :wave:
